description: GET /domains/records/{recordId} declares only the recordId path parameter, but like every other DNS operation it is scoped by the teamId and slug query parameters. Live probe (2026-11-11): `?teamId=` of the team that owns the record answered 200 with the record, and `?teamId=` of a team the token does not belong to answered 403 `forbidden` "Not authorized", so the endpoint reads the parameter. Without it the same token also read the record; its default team owns the domain. Vercel's Terraform provider passes `?teamId=` on this endpoint (https://github.com/vercel/terraform-provider-vercel/blob/152fffc2d661ac6b1583496635804d5107b45037/client/dns_record.go, GetDNSRecord).
